text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I want to buy a sports brace for

<chrname> to reduce the
strain on her
legs, so I make a trip to the
sports supplies shop.
However...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, so this is the place that just
opened shop,
huh?
Holy moly! Look at
that display—there's so much
to choose
from!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but maybe it's too much. I'm not sure what to get anymore!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Sorry to bother you, but...

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You looked a little lost. Are you looking
for a
sports brace, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
What does your trainee need? Let's
see...
choice_data_list: あ、ああ、実はそうなんだ
う、うん、実はそうなんだ
choice_data_list_en: Y-Yeah, to be honest, that's true.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If you want a brace that aids in bending
and
extension, I recommend you look at
the ones on
the second row. The eighth
row has a selection
that's great for
reducing strain.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but if your trainee's skin is sensitive,
the
braces on the fourth row are made
with
breathable materials.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you're too kind. But it's nothing
impressive.
All the information I know, I
obtained
secondhand.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I learned it all from the doctors and
nurses who
have been taking care of me
since long ago.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, sorry for going off-topic. I should
get going
now. I hope you didn't mind
the unsolicited
advice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her self-deprecating words, I
find
K.S.Miracle's advice very helpful
and feel much
better equipped to do my
shopping. I look at the
shelves and
decide to go with...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I pick out a brace designed for
functional
movement. While I wait in line
to pay for it, I hear
a familiar voice
coming from behind me.
choice_data_list: 動きを助けてくれるもの
つけ心地がよさそうなほう
choice_data_list_en: The one that looks more comfortable to wear.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: No way! Are these socks that goated?! Sheesh, the design is so peak too!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
They are quite adorable, as you say. I
think they
would suit you nicely.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
No cap? I've gotta get them, then!
You're a real
one, Miracle! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I pick out a brace designed for comfort.
While I
wait in line to pay for it, I hear a
familiar voice
coming from behind me.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: This looks like it would suit Ruby well...

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Okay, I think I'll get it.
